calibration.protocol: 2-task seed-0 diagnostic (campaign precedent), frozen before the screen

screen.protocol: 60 tasks x 5000 steps, exact protocol prefix, paired seeds 0-2

preregistered_promotion.method_criterion: screen > 0.80 (beats published SOTA with no network; report prominently)

reading: A gradient-free, network-free streaming naive Bayes (per-class annealed fast-EMA diagonal Gaussians) scores 0.78510 on the 60-task screen and beats the published-configuration UPGD-W control paired on the same seeds (+0.00734, all seeds).
It does NOT cross the pre-registered 0.80 method bar and sits ~0.079 below the conditioned deep champion (0.86396 screen) and ~0.064 below the rff_rls tracking control (0.8490 screen).

Placement: the closed-form class-conditional statistic tracker is stronger than the unconditioned published deep method but weaker than any arm with input conditioning; consistent with the campaign thesis that fast input-statistics tracking, not depth, is the protocol's binding resource.
